strings.name: Tony Fadell
strings.summary: After General Magic and Philips, Fadell led Apple teams developing the iPod and early iPhones. In 2010 he cofounded Nest, combining sensors, software and home devices; Google later acquired it. He subsequently moved into investing, product mentoring and writing Build. His 2025–26 MIT design residency and conversations emphasized that useful products depend on teams, manufacturing and user needs.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Helped develop the iPod and Nest, advancing consumer electronics, smart homes and integrated hardware-software product design.
